The '''Orthellin system''' lay in the [[Binarran Cloud/Legends|Binarran Cloud]], a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Orthellin royal mistress/Legends|Orthellin royal mistress]]|system=Orthellin [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> an affluent [[Orthellin royal mistress/Legends|Orthellin royal mistress]] who at one point owned the [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|luxury yacht]] [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']].<ref name="Thrawn">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Orthellin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
